capabilities: Install a plugin from a pasted directory or manifest.json URL
Validate manifest, id, version and files before writing to disk
Enable the installed plugin and confirm it loaded
Fill and install from three built-in example endpoints
Clean up a stale styles.css only on a real 404/410
disambiguation: It cannot install ready-made zip links; the host must serve the plugin files unpacked at their own paths.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). It warns that installing code is executing code and accepts only HTTPS (localhost excepted); it also documents the four undocumented app.plugins members it uses and that it never self-updates. Release assets carry GitHub Actions build provenance attestations.
intentEvidence: Inspired by BRAT, it does one thing only: fetch a plugin's files from a directory URL
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to install a plugin from an arbitrary URL, and on slow or restricted networks existing installers fail before the files come through.

relations.evidence: Inspired by BRAT, it does one thing only: fetch a plugin's files

summary: Plugin installer that fetches another Obsidian plugin's manifest.json, main.js and styles.css from a plain directory URL and enables it.
